title: Lightspeed server definition
description: The TOML server-definition files of PLAN.md §6, expressed over their decoded (JSON-equivalent) form. Two shapes are accepted and may not be mixed: one whole definition at the top level, or several under [servers.<name>]. Every file in the workspace and user layers is a *fragment*: it need only set the keys it changes, and the rest is inherited from the weaker layers (built-in defaults, then PATH sniffing). Only the merged result has to be complete, which is why nothing below is required except schema_version. Unknown keys are rejected by the loader rather than ignored, so a typo in root_markers is an error and not a server that silently never activates. Implemented by internal/serverdef; the built-in layer is generated into internal/serverdef/builtins_gen.go by internal/gen.

oneOf.title: Several definitions, named by table key

schema_version.description: The only version this build understands. Required in every file, including a fragment that changes one key.

name.description: The server this file describes. Present only in the one-definition shape; in the [servers.<name>] shape the table key names the server and this key is refused.

servers.description: Several definitions in one file, keyed by server name — what a polyglot repo needs in its single .lightspeed.toml.

name.description: Used as a human-facing identifier and as part of a session key, so it is constrained rather than free text.

definition.description: One server's tables inside [servers.<name>]. It carries no name and no schema_version: the table key names it, and the file's schema_version covers it.

activation.description: Which files this server claims, and how strongly. Arrays replace rather than merge when a stronger layer sets them: a shorter list is how a language or a glob is taken away.

languages.description: LSP language identifiers ("go", "rust"), not editor filetypes.

globs.description: Path patterns ("**/*.go"), relative to the resolved workspace root unless they begin with "/".

root_markers.description: File or directory names marking a workspace root, most significant first. ".git" belongs last, or it outranks every project marker.

priority.description: Orders servers claiming the same file: higher runs first. Absent means inherit; 50 is the default of the built-in table.

command.description: argv, command first. Never passed through a shell. command[0] is also the executable PATH sniffing looks for.

transport.description: The framing. Absent means stdio, the only transport in v1.

initialization_options.description: Sent verbatim as initializationOptions on the LSP initialize request. Merges key by key with weaker layers rather than replacing, so one knob can be changed without restating the tree.

settings.description: Sent verbatim as the settings of workspace/didChangeConfiguration, which several servers need after initialize (PLAN §5.4). Merges like initialization_options.

install.description: How to obtain the server. Delegation only: lightspeed never downloads anything itself, and a missing server exits 3 quoting the command below rather than running it (PLAN §6).

mise.description: A mise tool spec such as "go:golang.org/x/tools/gopls@v0.23.0" or "npm:@vtsls/language-server", passed to `mise use -g`. mise owns the backends, the checksums and the lockfile.
